typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		UID as string,
		DB_ID as long,
		ValidatedDate as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> tblPrismaEnrichedTCOOTDATA
tblPrismaEnrichedTCOOTDATA sink(input(
		UID as string,
		DB_ID as long,
		ValidatedDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UID,
		DB_ID,
		ValidatedDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
